purpose: Keep the application/runtime Richards temporal head budget explicit, versioned and independent of the trial outcome while preserving a strict distinction from coupling convergence, predictor perturbation and nonlinear solver tolerances.

coupling_head_residual_tolerance.meaning: allowed interface head residual for H_SWAP-H_GW

richards_temporal_head_budget.meaning: normalization budget for the qualified Richards temporal indicator C_h=B_inf/H_budget

predictor_head_perturbation.native_unit: cm pressure head for the frozen F-GC02 fixture
predictor_head_perturbation.meaning: distinct candidate head used to exercise predictor/corrector response

budget_provenance_record.selection_rule: The value must be selected and frozen independently of the trial B_inf, C_h or accept/reject result.
budget_provenance_record.runtime_requirement: The complete provenance record must be available before the first physical attempt for an interval that uses the certificate.
budget_provenance_record.missing_or_invalid_behavior: certificate unavailable; transaction fails closed according to qualified F-KT11/F-VQ34 semantics
budget_provenance_record.diagnostic_requirement: Expose budget supplied/valid/native value together with provenance_id and policy_version at the runtime/coupling diagnostic surface.

requirements: numeric finite positive value exists before execution
source identity and policy version are immutable for the qualification run
value is not selected from the current trial B_inf or outcome
template value is established on evidence disjoint from the target trial
template scope is explicit and not material-specific post-hoc tuning
qualification establishes the policy use, not merely one target-trial pass

nonadmissible_provenance_classes.F_VQ34_QUALIFICATION_ONLY_BUDGET_CONSTRU: qualification oracle is not an application policy
nonadmissible_provenance_classes.FGC02_PREDICTOR_HEAD_PERTURBATION: trial perturbation is not an accuracy budget
nonadmissible_provenance_classes.NONLINEAR_NEWTON_TOLERANCE: different numerical error source and owner
nonadmissible_provenance_classes.UNQUALIFIED_COUPLING_HEAD_RESIDUAL_TOLER: interface convergence quantity is not automatically the model temporal indicator budget

unit_policy.note: Unit conversion is permitted only after the semantic owner has supplied a legitimate budget quantity; conversion itself cannot create that budget.

error_claim_boundary.qualified_claim: C_h is a dimensionless acceptance certificate for the qualified bounded stiffness-aware Richards temporal indicator relative to an explicitly supplied budget.

all_required: F-VQ34 qualified production certificate binding remains source-locked
exact F-GC02 physical fixture remains unchanged
finite positive numeric H_budget with admissible provenance is frozen before any target-trial execution
budget value is independent of F-GC02 B_inf and result
hard mass remains an earlier absolute gate
fresh independent F-VQ admission workunit is opened and matrix/contract is frozen before execution
frozen_FGC02_reexecution_release_conditi.current_missing_item: finite positive numeric H_budget with admissible independent application/runtime provenance
